correctness.rationale: The complete assigned RESULT.md has exact simple Krawtchouk eigenvectors with eigenvalue J(d-2k), and K_1=d-2k, K_2=((d-2k)^2-d)/2. Strict positivity of independent loss rates makes undamped eigenspaces precisely eigenlines zero on all sinks; a reducing-subspace argument gives all-density-matrix eventual capture. K_2 has exactly two integral roots for square d>=4 and none otherwise; K_1 has one only when d even; their roots never coincide. The endpoint survival for d=s^2 is 2*binom(d,(d-s)/2)/2^d, equal to 21/64 at d=9. The e^{-1/2} local-binomial factor follows from one-standard-deviation local CLT. Independent direct integer Krawtchouk sums checked d=3..42 and nonintersection, not substituted for the proof. No statement extends to finite-time capture, other hopping, or collective sinks.
